lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple horizontal rows of high-luminance circular clusters organized in a grid-like arrangement posterior to the gill slits, with spot size and intensity appearing greatest in the mid-lateral region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, creating a structured matrix of anchor nodes across the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal ridges running parallel across the upper flank, characterized by high-intensity pixel values on the superior edge and a sharp shadow-induced gradient on the inferior edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A scattered distribution of approximately 12 high-luminance blobs contained within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin, primarily concentrated in the basal and central regions.

other_distinctive_markers: Several elongated, high-contrast silhouettes representing secondary organisms are positioned in the immediate ventral vicinity of the pectoral fin and lower flank.
